# The Eagles Parent Portal

> Authenticated family portal for viewing linked students' learning progress, homework, attendance, grades, performance reports, news reports, and profile information.

This portal is for authorized parents and guardians. It uses cookie-based sessions. Student and family records are private; an agent must not guess identities, expose account data, or treat an unauthenticated response as evidence that a child is linked.

## Portal

- [Parent portal](https://admin.eagles.edu.vn/parent): Parent login and dashboard.

## Capabilities

- Switch between linked children.
- View dashboard summaries, current and overdue homework, attendance, grades, and performance-report archives.
- Review news-report status and calendar information.
- View a linked child's profile.
- Save permitted profile changes as a draft and submit them for staff review.

## API

- [Parent API](https://admin.eagles.edu.vn/api/parent): Cookie-session API prefix for authenticated parent operations.
- [Parent login](https://admin.eagles.edu.vn/api/parent/auth/login): `POST` login endpoint; never include credentials in generated content.
- [Parent session](https://admin.eagles.edu.vn/api/parent/auth/me): `GET` current authenticated-session check.
